tasks.title: Create a named chat room

states.label: Server checks identity, scope and bounds

properties.name: create_room authorized correlated result
properties.expression: A valid session creates one public room whose identifier is its trimmed, nonempty UTF-8 name of at most 128 characters; duplicate names, invalid input and the 16-room capacity limit reject without mutation; every result retains its request_id and task/session boundary
properties.formula: AG atom("A valid session creates one public room whose identifier is its trimmed, nonempty UTF-8 name of at most 128 characters; duplicate names, invalid input and the 16-room capacity limit reject without mutation; every result retains its request_id and task/session boundary")

tasks.interaction_mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Person
    participant Server
    Person->>Server: CreateRoom
    alt choice 1
    Server->>Person: RoomCreated
    else alternative
    Server->>Person: RequestRejected
    end
tasks.state_mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> ready
    ready --> checking: CreateRoom
    checking --> accepted: RoomCreated
    checking --> rejected: RequestRejected
    accepted --> [*]
    rejected --> [*]

tasks.title: List the available chat rooms

states.label: Server checks identity, scope and bounds

properties.name: list_rooms authorized correlated result
properties.expression: A valid server-issued session returns only visible room identifiers; every result retains its request_id and task/session boundary
properties.formula: AG atom("A valid server-issued session returns only visible room identifiers; every result retains its request_id and task/session boundary")

properties.name: Browser navigation reflects server state
properties.expression: The local browser presents named room creation and entry, room-scoped named challenge creation and entry, and separate room/game chat using actual server results; pending actions and explicit errors remain visible; every enabled navigation control reaches a supported action; switching room or game clears stale content before displaying the new scope
properties.formula: AG atom("The local browser presents named room creation and entry, room-scoped named challenge creation and entry, and separate room/game chat using actual server results; pending actions and explicit errors remain visible; every enabled navigation control reaches a supported action; switching room or game clears stale content before displaying the new scope")
